protocol: RAAF A profile interrupted during chamber ascent for an emergency descent.
outcome_window: Clinical symptoms during rapid ascent and residual visual disturbance after descent.
locator: Primary report pp. 172–173, A profile, Case Report and outcomes (PDF pp. 1–2)
note: The standard A profile aimed for 25,000 ft. The subject first described symptoms early in the rapid ascent, at an unspecified altitude, and signaled distress at 18,000 ft. The actual chamber peak was 19,500 ft. The authors diagnosed pulmonary barotrauma and cerebral arterial gas embolism. Weenink et al. later rated the evidence possible CAGE under their review criteria.
